Amazed at Rams's prowess, he addressed tbat great warrior, 
skilled in the scriptural traditions, as also in the use of every

" 0 Lion among Men, with rhine arrows, thou art able to

Rama, embracing the handsome Sugriva, like unto Lal:sh-
mana, in his great wisdom answered him, saying:-
" Let us leave here without delay for Kishkindha. Do thou 
precede us. When we come to tbat city, 0 Sugriva, it is for

Thereafter they started out in aU haste for Kishkindha, Bali's 
capital. Concealing themselves behind some trees, they

When the powerful Bali heard his brother emitting rhis
